prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in League City, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1233; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision you reported. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather just go over what happened, but I can confirm I'm the driver of the vehicle involved.

Q: Understood. Can you walk me through what you were doing right before the collision?

A: I was heading to the grocery store on the main road in League City. I needed to turn left into the parking lot, so I signaled and slowed down.

Q: Did you come to a complete stop or continue through the turn?

A: I was already moving slowly through the intersection when I started the turn. There was a gap in oncoming traffic, and I thought I had enough room.

Q: What happened next?

A: The other car came from the opposite direction and hit my front driver's side. It happened fast. I didn't see it until it was almost on me.

Q: Were you injured?

A: Yes. I put my right arm out on the steering wheel and then against the door. My wrist hurt right away. I was taken to the hospital, and they told me it was fractured.

Q: Did you have any passengers in your vehicle?

A: No, I was alone.

Q: Did you speak with the other driver or any witnesses at the scene?

A: The other driver was shaken up but okay. I didn't really talk to anyone else. A police officer came and took information.

Q: Is there anything you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I'm still doing physical therapy for the wrist, and I'd like to be kept updated on the claim.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
